name: Mandelbrot Lab
desc: A Mandelbrot-set explorer: escape-time rendering of z → z² + c with pan, zoom, four named regions and live escape-iteration readouts.
controls: Max-iterations and zoom sliders, four presets (full set/seahorse/elephant/spiral), zoom in/out and reset buttons, drag to pan, scroll to zoom; keys 1–4 load presets, +/− zoom, R resets
creator: Original build (Dragon Gaming Assets)
